info.name: Stitchers
info.plot: Descrive le avventure di una giovane donna reclutata da un agenzia governativa segreta per essere "cucita" (stitched) nelle menti di persone decedute di recente per leggere le loro memorie e usarle per investigarne le cause della morte.

translations.value: Descrive le avventure di una giovane donna reclutata da un agenzia governativa segreta per essere "cucita" (stitched) nelle menti di persone decedute di recente per leggere le loro memorie e usarle per investigarne le cause della morte.

episodes.name: Viaggio nei ricordi
episodes.plot: Kirsten, una studentessa con una con displasia temporale, è reclutata da un’agenzia governativa segreta per risolvere i crimini avendo accesso alla memoria delle persone appena decedute.

translations.value: Kirsten, una studentessa con una con displasia temporale, è reclutata da un’agenzia governativa segreta per risolvere i crimini avendo accesso alla memoria delle persone appena decedute.

episodes.name: Amici nei bassifondi
episodes.plot: Una giovane donna è vittima di una nuova droga mortale, la squadra cerca di risalire a chi sta diffondendo la droga, le loro indagini s’incrociano con quelle del detective Fisher.

translations.value: Una giovane donna è vittima di una nuova droga mortale, la squadra cerca di risalire a chi sta diffondendo la droga, le loro indagini s’incrociano con quelle del detective Fisher.

episodes.name: Connessioni
episodes.plot: Una giovane moglie è uccisa durante la luna di miele, ma le prove contro di lui non sono sufficienti. Kristen durante l’immersione nella vasca per connettersi con la vittima si convince della colpevolezza del marito. Nel frattempo Linus lega con Camilla.

episodes.name: Ti vedo
episodes.plot: Il vicino di casa di Cameron viene ucciso, la squadra organizza un appostamento a casa di Cameron per capire se lui era il vero bersaglio. Nel frattempo, Kirsten viene a sapere qualcosa di più su come sono andate le cose a Marta, la ragazza che l’ha preceduta nello Stitch.

episodes.name: Il giovane Stitcher
episodes.plot: I sospetti di Kristen sui suoi colleghi aumentano quando scopre un algoritmo per il programma Stitchers nelle carte nascoste di un teorico della cospirazione. Nel frattempo, una fonte inaspettata invia a Kirsten messaggi misteriosi.

translations.value: I sospetti di Kristen sui suoi colleghi aumentano quando scopre un algoritmo per il programma Stitchers nelle carte nascoste di un teorico della cospirazione. Nel frattempo, una fonte inaspettata invia a Kirsten messaggi misteriosi.

episodes.name: Finalmente
episodes.plot: Un ricercatore è in terapia intensiva dopo un incidente automobilistico e Kirsten è determinata a scoprire cosa è successo. Nel frattempo, Kirsten vuole l’aiuto di Linus a decifrare un indizio lasciato da Ed Clark. Kirsten cerca informazioni sulle radici del programma Stitchers.

episodes.name: La radice di tutti i mali
episodes.plot: Il ragazzo di Kirsten viene a trovarla senza preavviso e Maggie decide di fare qualche ricerca su di lui, nel frattempo il resto della squadra è sorpreso quando scopre che Kirsten è fidanzata. La stravagante vita sociale di una giovane donna può fornire informazioni sulla sua morte.

episodes.name: Compleanno in quarantena
episodes.plot: Il team viene messo in quarantena mentre lavora sul suicidio di un ricercatore e un virus, che si trasmette per via aerea, infetta il laboratorio facendo ammalare i membri della squadra.

episodes.name: Tempo futuro
episodes.plot: La squadra indaga sull’omicidio di un sensitivo molto popolare. Nel frattempo, Camille accetta di incontrare i genitori di Linus, ma la cosa non la entusiasma.

episodes.name: Punto
episodes.plot: Fischer è ferito in una sparatoria, Kirsten si connette ai ricordi di una cameriera morta e mette la squadra sulle tracce di un esperto di sicurezza connesso sia a Maggie che alla madre di Kristen. Linus è sempre più geloso di Camille quando Cameron la allena come suo rinforzo.

episodes.name: When Darkness Falls
episodes.plot: While Camille preps for her annual Halloween bash, the Stitchers team investigates the suicide of a young man, who may have abducted a missing college student. The stitch leaves Kirsten spooked, and she begins to worry she’s being haunted by him as they race to find the missing girl.

episodes.plot: Kirsten successfully revives Cameron, but finds that stitching into a live consciousness is now causing her to experience real emotions for the first time.

episodes.name: Hack Me If You Can
episodes.plot: When a black hat hacker dies after an extortion scheme gone wrong, the  team learns he was involved with a website dedicated to infidelity. As  the case develops, Kirsten discovers that the hacker was actually set up  by someone with an extreme thirst for revenge. But when the killer  turns their attention to the team's  personal lives, the Stitchers find themselves in grave danger at every  turn. Meanwhile, Cameron's recent brush with death gives him a new  perspective on life, and Linus finally moves out of his parents' house  and into a fully equipped smart house

episodes.name: The One That Got Away
episodes.plot: When Fisher's mentor turns up dead, Kirsten's stitch reveals the officer was murdered by a serial killer she's been chasing for years. Camille's rebellious older brother Theo arrives in town with a whole lot of trouble. Meanwhile, Cameron is finally honest with Kirsten about his feelings for her.

episodes.name: The Two Deaths of Jamie B.
episodes.plot: When an unidentified, severely damaged body is recovered in a dumpster, Kirsten’s stitch divulges that the victim has two death scenes from two very different times in his life. Camille tires of her brother Theo’s irresponsible ways and finally puts her foot down. Linus turns to Cameron for help with a sticky situation. Detective Fisher and Kirsten uncover a clue about her father.

episodes.name: Midnight Stitcher
episodes.plot: When a young woman falls to her death with a cryptic note attached to her body, Kirsten is convinced the message is somehow tied to her own past.

episodes.name: The Dying Shame
episodes.plot: When a Chinese pop diva is killed, her female bodyguard is blamed for the murder, who appears to have been passed out at the time of the homicide.

episodes.name: Pretty Little Lawyers
episodes.plot: When a bright, young lawyer is found dead, the team suspects she was murdered because of a case she was working on. After theorizing the lawyer was killed because she discovered something criminal about her firm’s high profile client, the team heads to the firm to interview her four ambitious coworkers, each of whom seems more suspicious than the last. While at the firm, Maggie crosses paths with a former college boyfriend who may be closer to the murder than she’d like to admit. Meanwhile, Camille’s interactions with Liam take a surprising turn, and Kirsten learns something shocking during the stitch.

episodes.name: Red Eye
episodes.plot: When a plane lands in Los Angeles with multiple dead passengers and no apparent cause, the Stitchers team sweeps into action. Now racing against the clock to determine if this is a terrorist attack or the work of a fellow passenger, Kirsten is tasked with stitching into one victim after another to learn exactly what happened. Cameron worries about Kirsten’s well-being and their new dynamic in light of his relationship with Nina. Meanwhile, Camille tries to help Linus through a personal issue, and Liam continues to cause problems.

episodes.name: The Guest
episodes.plot: Mitchell Blair directs Kirsten to shut down all investigation into finding her father. But Kirsten has finally made contact with someone she thinks can lead her to him. To gain her source’s trust, she tries to explain her role in the Stitchers program, without actually revealing the program’s nature. Treading carefully, Kirsten recounts the team’s current case, in which a series of murders is tied to a wildly popular new app.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.plot: Now closer than ever to uncovering the mysteries surrounding her parents, Kirsten’s mind is threatened when her stitch leads her deep into the recesses of her own memories.

episodes.name: Out of the Shadows
episodes.plot: Fueled by his love for Kirsten, Cameron finds a way to bring her back to reality, but it could cost them their relationship. Meanwhile, the Stitchers lab is on lockdown, leaving an anxious Linus unable to check on his father’s condition after surgery. But, as the team prepares to be reassigned for breaking protocol, NSA Director Mitchell Blair surprises everyone by demanding an emergency stitch that yields shocking new information.

episodes.plot: The Stitchers team investigates the case of a young woman found dead in her wealthy boyfriend’s pool. Meanwhile, Linus feels a connection to Ivy, Cameron has growing concern for Kirsten’s emotional vulnerability and Camille is intrigued by an attractive medical examiner who likes to meet in unusual places.

episodes.plot: A high-profile divorce attorney is murdered and the Stitchers team must sort through a plethora of suspects. Meanwhile, Linus discovers the cause of the neurosync issues in the stitches, which directly affects Kirsten and Cameron.

episodes.plot: When an MI6 agent is found dead, Kirsten struggles to sort through his memories due to the visual codes that the spy used to keep secrets. Meanwhile, Linus and Camille go on a double date, but not with each other.

episodes.name: Paternis
episodes.plot: Cameron’s estranged father, currently serving time in prison for white-collar crimes, is accused of murdering a prison guard. Going against protocol, Kirsten stitches into the guard’s memory for clues.

episodes.name: The Gremlin and the Fixer
episodes.plot: After an engineer ends up dead, his colleague and work rival becomes a suspect. However, upon examining some stitches, Kirsten and the team uncover that he was a part of an underground gaming club. The team races to save a falling satellite while Cameron takes a walk on the wild side when he infiltrates the gaming ring to get close to another suspect.
